gaze_valid_min_pct.rule: session valid gaze below this: WARN, a sensitivity restriction and not an exclusion

gaze_second_valid_min_pct.rule: a second counts as valid gaze at or above this share

analysable_min_minutes.rule: less analysable natural work: FAIL, a session exclusion

sync_min_usable.rule: fewer usable sync checks: FAIL, the session is excluded if sync cannot be recovered by hand

pupil_in_range_pct.rule: per eye, over worn samples, before the blink mask

gap_ms.rule: a longer interval is a gap

gap_total_fail_s.rule: no gap: PASS; less in total: WARN; otherwise FAIL

span_s.rule: a stream may start late or end early by this much

span_event_warn_s.rule: event streams may be quiet this long at either edge

part_boundary_s.rule: time lost where a recorder started a new file

heart_tail_note_s.rule: heart recorder stopped up to this much early: WARN; more, or a late start: FAIL

log_tail_note_s.rule: log ends up to this much after the recording: WARN; more: FAIL

marker_s.rule: marker further from the recording start: WARN, never FAIL

sync_expected.rule: a different number of logged sync checks: WARN

sync_window_s.rule: where a sync flash may be, relative to the logged tap

sync_drift_max_ms_per_hour.rule: more drift: WARN; a drift inside the measurement floor passes as within resolution

sync_drift_min_baseline_h.rule: a shorter baseline, or a floor at or above the drift limit: WARN, not resolvable

streams.rule: rate: absolute floors in Hz, or relative deviation from nominal

sync_residual_ms.rule: reported; set {pass, warn} in ms to grade it

pupil_after_mask_pct.rule: reported; set {pass, warn} in % to grade it

gaze_seconds_valid_pct.rule: reported; set {pass, warn} in % to grade it
